mobilize-duo.note: Rear-wheel drive (propulsion); orders stopped end of 2025, runout only

renault-renault-5.note: FWD only; the limited-series R5 Turbo 3E (rear in-wheel motors, RWD) is not counted (deliveries planned from 2027)

dacia-sandero.note: Sandero Stepway is FWD only as well

renault-renault-4.note: FWD only (optional 'Extended Grip' traction control); 4x4 versions (4 Savane 4x4, JP 4x4) are concepts only

renault-scenic-e-tech.note: Single front motor only; no dual-motor version

dacia-bigster.note: 4x4 via the new hybrid 150 4x4 (48V mild-hybrid 1.2 petrol on the front axle + electric rear-axle motor, 6-speed DCT; bi-fuel 'hybrid-G 150 4x4' in LPG markets); hybrid 155 and LPG versions FWD; the earlier manual mild hybrid 140 4x4 may still be listed in some markets

dacia-duster.note: 4x4 via the new hybrid 150 4x4 (48V mild-hybrid 1.2 petrol on the front axle + electric rear-axle motor, 6-speed DCT; bi-fuel 'hybrid-G 150 4x4' in LPG markets); hybrid 155 and LPG versions FWD; the earlier manual 4x4 may still be listed in some markets

dacia-striker.note: 4x4 only with the hybrid 150 4x4 (mild-hybrid petrol + electric rear axle) listed on the Swiss site; hybrid 155 and LPG versions FWD

alpine-a390.note: GT and GTS both have three motors (one front, two rear with torque vectoring); no 2WD version

renault-espace.note: Full hybrid E-Tech 200 only; 'Allradlenkung' (4Control) is four-wheel steering, not AWD

renault-rafale.note: AWD only with the E-Tech 4x4 300 PS plug-in hybrid (rear e-motor); full hybrid 200 is FWD

renault-trafic-passenger.note: No factory 4x4; third-party conversions are not listed by Renault

renault-trafic-van-mid.note: Diesel and E-Tech electric both FWD; no 4x4 in the Renault CH line-up

renault-master.note: RWD on long (L3/L4) and heavy chassis-cab versions; L2 FWD only; no 4x4 listed by Renault for the new generation

byd-dolphin-g.note: Single DM-i plug-in hybrid model; no AWD version listed

byd-atto-2.note: BEV (single front drive motor) and Atto 2 DM-i plug-in hybrid both FWD; no AWD version listed

byd-atto-3.note: Atto 3 EVO (2026): single rear motor 230 kW RWD or dual-motor 330 kW AWD; the pre-facelift Atto 3 was FWD

byd-seal.note: Comfort (170 kW) and Design (230 kW) RWD; Excellence AWD 390 kW dual motor

byd-seal-u.note: AWD only on the top DM-i version (dual motor, 0-100 km/h 5.9 s); Boost/Comfort FWD

byd-sealion-5.note: Single DM-i plug-in hybrid model; no AWD version listed

byd-sealion-7.note: Comfort RWD (single rear motor); Design and Excellence AWD (dual motor)

denza-z9-gt.note: Z9GT EV: three motors (one front, two rear) with AWD on the e³ platform; Z9GT DM-i plug-in hybrid also listed (specs pending, tri-motor AWD as in China)

byd-tang.note: Electric 7-seater sold only as dual-motor AWD

byd-ti-7.note: Sold as Ti 7 DM-p (performance plug-in hybrid with front and rear motors); UK page names only the DM-p model and does not spell out the drive layout

denza-d9.note: Only the D9 DM-i plug-in hybrid is listed in Germany, with AWD ('Das DM-i System gewährleistet Allradantrieb'); BEV D9 not listed on the DE site; specs still preliminary

byd-shark.note: DMO plug-in hybrid pickup with intelligent AWD; no 2WD version listed

ora-ora-5.note: 1.5 turbo petrol (DCT) and hybrid (DHT) listed with no AWD option; electric version (150 kW) marked coming soon

wey-wey-03.note: 2.0 PHEV: FWD (front e-motor 120 kW, 270 kW system) or AWD (front 120 kW + rear 135 kW e-motors, 325 kW system); marked 'Auslaufmodell' (runout) in Germany

haval-jolion-pro.note: 1.5 turbo (130 kW) with 7-speed DCT; no AWD listed

wey-wey-05.note: 2.0 PHEV with front (120 kW) and rear (135 kW) e-motors, 350 kW system, AWD only; marked 'Auslaufmodell' (runout) in Germany

haval-h6.note: H6 Hybrid (1.5 turbo + 130 kW e-motor, 179 kW system) only; no AWD listed (GWM Germany labels FWD/AWD only for the separate H7)

cadillac-optiq.note: Standard dual-motor AWD; no RWD version listed in Switzerland

cadillac-lyriq.note: Standard dual-motor AWD (528 PS, Sport/Luxury); Lyriq-V also AWD; no RWD version in Europe

cadillac-vistiq.note: Standard dual-motor AWD (646 PS); no RWD version

chevrolet-corvette.note: AWD only on the E-Ray hybrid (electric front axle); Stingray and Z06 RWD; ZR1 not listed on the European site

tesla-model-3.note: Standard and Premium RWD single motor; Premium Long Range AWD and Performance dual motor

tesla-model-y.note: Standard and Premium RWD single motor; Premium Long Range AWD and Performance dual motor

piaggio-porter-np6.note: Rear-drive micro truck (single or dual-tyre rear axle, standard or short final drive for HD versions); no 4x4 offered
